kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحتضرون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِرُونَ (taḥtaḍirūna) /taħ.ta.dˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# تُحْتَضَرُونَ (tuḥtaḍarūna) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
